decisionBasis.acceptedDirection: Preserve current repository, code, semantic, data and native owners. Unify the common context entrypoint and execution contract first; do not perform an education monorepo migration.
decisionBasis.dailyRecordBoundary: Retain internal attendance, progress, homework, assessments and journal intake. Parent-facing drafting and transmission are excluded.
decisionBasis.scopeOfAcceptance: Architecture direction and planning artifacts only. This acceptance is not activation, operational completion, mathematical acceptance or authorization for a specific source effect.

runtimeBoundary.commonHarnessRole: Consume existing pinned Work/Memory/context identity and verification references. Do not fork canonical validators, add Work as an Artifact kind or create a second execution loop.
runtimeBoundary.effectOwner: Existing domain/native owner selected for an exact current authorized operation.
runtimeBoundary.uncertainOutcomeRule: Do not retry an ambiguous effect. Reconcile exact authoritative target state, receipts and preserved completed/uncertain effects first.
runtimeBoundary.teacherEvidenceRule: Original teacher evidence remains independently owned and preserved; source/server receipt, execution authorization, verification and teacher acceptance are different records.

findings.finding: Education root checks traverse the registered module graph; the academy check route invokes only gang-a and dc-gang-a. Month-end-workbench/web and external research projection dependencies have separate checks but are absent from this aggregate route.
findings.impact: A root aggregate pass must not be reported as complete verification of teacher research, candidate inspection and assessment preparation.
findings.nextImprovement: Inventory existing module-local verification entrypoints, then propose explicit capability nodes and exact task-to-check coverage in the owning repository.
findings.acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Owner-reviewed graph/coverage update plus source/synthetic checks that exercise the intended workflow packages and explicitly retain native, physical, teacher and pedagogical limits.

findings.finding: Four full canonical domain workpacks and curriculum-boundary original bytes are absent from the export; the declared boundary pin/hash-method discrepancy remains unresolved.
findings.impact: UI/source-envelope preservation cannot establish complete curriculum semantics, prerequisites or whole-curriculum audit coverage.
findings.nextImprovement: Keep source inventory and explicit unknowns visible; identify the original supported acquisition owner and exact revisions before any separately scoped import proposal. Do not ask for a duplicate upload solely because canonical/ is empty.
findings.acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Verified original identity, byte length, declared serialization/hash method, revision and bindings; explicit updated inventory and bounded semantic audit.

findings.finding: Older research history retains proposed 9/9/6 allocation and unselected questions; later Education Work records confirmed 8/8/8 preparation, then a later exact teacher selection and explicit two-questions-under-one-type exception. General 100-minute policy and specific 80-minute assessment have different scopes.
findings.impact: Reading a short retained exam specification or choosing the newest entire document can reintroduce superseded uncertainty or falsely accept an earlier ranking.
findings.nextImprovement: Resolve current claims by assessment identity, field, source revision and explicit corrects/supersedes relation; retain every historical proposal and its scope.
findings.acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: A context packet shows current decisions and excluded history together, preserves the explicit selection exception, and never infers exam date, edition, timezone, mathematical acceptance or native activation.

findings.finding: Containment, is-a, prerequisite, evidence support, workflow order, source supersession and repository verification dependencies already have different meanings and cycle rules. Domain object IDs, classification paths, native IDs and Work/Task/Run IDs are separate.
findings.impact: A single parent tree or shared string ID would collapse source meaning, workflow sequencing, identity and evidence into unjustified equivalences.
findings.nextImprovement: Use a topic hierarchy for navigation, explicit typed edges for cross-topic relations and revision-qualified crosswalks for source identity. Keep local/native identity joins evidence-backed and preserve unknown/conflicting states.
findings.acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Contract checks reject label-only joins, invalid relation endpoints, unintended containment/dependency cycles and Work/domain identity substitution without imposing acyclicity on all relatedness.

stages.outcome: One context entrypoint with source coverage, current user scope, topic hierarchy, typed graph links and the seven non-activated workflow contracts.
stages.closure: Review metadata references, types, exclusions, source/current/history distinctions and user interview answers. This closes a planning artifact, not an operational workflow.

stages.owner: academy-workbench context owner with existing domain source owners
stages.closure: Use synthetic inputs first. A subsequent real packet requires separately scoped exact student/class/date/source-read authorization; do not copy payloads into Git.

stages.outcome: Repair task-to-verification coverage and scoped current-decision resolution at their current owners.
stages.closure: Review exact source patches and meaningful synthetic checks; retain existing native-launch and semantic acceptance holds.

stages.outcome: Resolve source gaps only in admitted owner-specific units, then add minimal native/domain handoffs where a real operation needs them.
stages.owner: Original source acquisition and native/domain execution owners
stages.closure: Exact scope, current authorization, immutable source identity, supported execution mechanism, authoritative readback and separate teacher review. No repository/data migration follows automatically.
